## Interactions & Behaviors

### Left Rail Smart List item click

- Active item gets blue highlight
- [INFERRED] Hovering shows a "..." or settings icon to edit/delete that smart list

### "Edit" button next to page title
- [INFERRED] Opens an inline editor or modal to rename the smart list, change its visibility, or edit metadata (not the same as editing filters)

### "? How Smart Lists work" link
- [INFERRED] Opens a help/documentation modal or tooltip explaining smart list logic

### "Columns" button
- **Toggles the Columns picker dropdown** open/closed
- Dropdown is a two-panel floating panel: left panel selects category, right panel toggles individual columns
- Left panel categories are clickable — clicking switches the right panel to show that category's columns
- Right panel checkboxes are individually togglable — checking/unchecking adds/removes that column from the table immediately [INFERRED]
- Closing the dropdown (clicking outside or clicking "Columns" again) commits the column selection

### Column category checkboxes in Columns picker
- The check state in the left panel is a read-only indicator (not directly clickable) — shows if any column in that category is enabled
- [INFERRED] Clicking a category row in the left panel switches the right panel view

### Individual column checkboxes in Columns picker
- Clicking toggles that column's visibility in the table
- [INFERRED] Changes are reflected immediately in the table (live update without a save step, though "Update List" may persist it)

### "Update List" button
- Saves the current filter + column configuration back to the smart list definition permanently

### Settings/share icon (next to "Update List")
- [INFERRED] Opens options for sharing the smart list with other agents, duplicating it, or managing list settings

### "Filters (7)" button
- Toggles the right Filters panel open/closed

### Filter row in Filters panel

## Data Model Signals

### Entities
- **Person / Contact** — primary entity; fields: id, name (first + last), created_at, last_visit_at, last_communication_at, last_text_received_phone, stage, tags (array), source, assigned_agent, price, updated_at, last_activity_at
- **Smart List** — entity with id (integer, e.g., 37), name ("All Expireds"), filter_conditions (array), column_config (array of enabled column keys), total_count (477), owner/sharing settings
- **Tag** — entity applied to contacts; used in filter conditions; example values: "Expired Listing", "compliance:hard-stop" (or similar), "Unsubscribed"
- **Stage** — enum-like field on Person; example excluded value: "Active Clients"; implies other stages like "Expired Listing" is a tag not a stage
- **Agent / User** — referenced in filter "Agent includes any of: Matt Ryan"; assigned to contacts
- **Collection** — grouping of smart lists (e.g., Pipeline collection contains multiple lists)
- **Phone** — sub-entity on Person; has attributes: number (E.164 or formatted), is_good (boolean), is_sms_capable (boolean)
- **Communication** — event on Person; has: type (text/call/email), timestamp, preview_text, direction (inbound/outbound)

### Field types / operators revealed
- **Tags** — multi-value array; operators: "exclude any of", "include any of" (multi-select, comma-separated)
- **Last Communication** — date/timestamp; operator: "more than [X] [days/weeks/months] ago"
- **Stage** — single-select enum; operator: "excludes any of" (multi-select from stage list)
- **Phone is good** — boolean; no operator, just present/absent
- **Agent** — single or multi-select from agent list; operator: "includes any of"

### Relationships
- Person → many Tags
- Person → one Stage
- Person → one or many Agents (assigned)
- Person → many Communications (timeline)
- Person → many Phones
- Smart List → many Filter Conditions
- Smart List → many Column Configs
- Collection → many Smart Lists
- Neighborhood → many Smart Lists (separate section)

### Enum / example values
- **Tags seen:** "Expired Listing", "Unsubscribed" (excluded), compliance tag (excluded), "Expired" + others (included)
- **Stages:** "Active Clients" (excluded), implying at least: Active Clients, Expired Listing (possibly), Lead, Past Client, etc.
- **Phone icon states:** good (green), sms-capable (purple), not-good (presumably red or absent)
- **Sort directions:** ascending (↑), descending (↓)
- **Column filter operators on tags/stage:** "▼" funnel icon

```
        <ManageLink href="/people/lists" />
      </SmartListsSection>
    </NavSection>
  </LeftRail>

  <MainContent>
    <PageHeader>
      <h1>All Expireds</h1>
      <EditButton />
    </PageHeader>

    <Toolbar>
      <HowSmartListsWorkLink />
      <ColumnsButton onClick={toggleColumnsPicker} active={columnsOpen} />
      <PresetViewSelector label="Out Of State Home ..." />
      <FiltersButton count={7} onClick={toggleFiltersPanel} active={filtersOpen} />
      <UpdateListButton />
      <ListSettingsButton />
    </Toolbar>

    <ResultsBar>
      <span>Showing {filteredCount} people</span>
      {/* bulk action icons */}
    </ResultsBar>

    {columnsOpen && (
      <ColumnsPickerDropdown>
        <CategoryPanel>
          <CategoryItem label="Details" count={10} checked={true} active />
          <CategoryItem label="Assigned" count={2} checked={true} />
          <CategoryItem label="Emails" count={1} checked={true} />
          <CategoryItem label="Calls" checked={false} />
          <CategoryItem label="Texts" count={1} checked={true} />
          <CategoryItem label="Website activity" count={5} checked={false} />
          <CategoryItem label="Deals" checked={false} />
          <CategoryItem label="Inbox Apps" checked={false} />
          <CategoryItem label="Custom Fields" checked={false} />
        </CategoryPanel>
        <ColumnPanel category="Details">
          <ColumnToggle label="Price" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle label="Tags" checked={true} filterable />
          <ColumnToggle label="Stage" checked={true} filterable />
          <ColumnToggle label="Source" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle label="Created" checked={true} sortActive sortDir="desc" />
          <ColumnToggle label="Updated" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle label="Inactive" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle label="My Next Task" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle label="Last Activity" checked={true} />
          <ColumnToggle label="Last Communication" checked={true} filterable />
          <ColumnToggle label="Timeframe" checked={false} />
          <ColumnToggle label="My Agent Status" checked={false} />
        </ColumnPanel>
      </ColumnsPickerDropdown>
    )}

    <PeopleTable sortColumn="created" sortDir="desc">
      <TableHeader>
        <Col field="name" label="Name" />
        <Col field="created_at" label="Created" sortActive sortDir="desc" />
        <Col field="last_visit_at" label="Last Visit" />
        <Col field="last_communication_at" label="Last Communication" filterable />
        <Col field="last_text_received" label="Last Text Received" />
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {contacts.map(contact => (
          <ContactRow key={contact.id}>
            <ContactAvatar initials={contact.initials} color={contact.avatarColor} />
            <ContactName>{contact.name}</ContactName>
            <ContactSubLabel>{contact.primaryTag}</ContactSubLabel>
            <CreatedCell>{contact.created_at}</CreatedCell>
            <LastVisitCell>{contact.last_visit_at}</LastVisitCell>
            <LastCommCell preview={contact.lastCommPreview}>{contact.last_communication_at}</LastCommCell>
            <LastTextCell>
              <PhoneNumber number={contact.phone} />
              {contact.phone?.isGood && <PhoneGoodBadge />}
              {contact.phone?.isSmsCapable && <SmsBadge />}
            </LastTextCell>
          </ContactRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </PeopleTable>
  </MainContent>

  {filtersOpen && (
    <FiltersPanel filterCount={7}>
      <AddFilterInput placeholder="Add a filter" />
      <FilterRow field="tags" operator="excludes_any" value={["compliance..."]} expandable />
      <FilterRow field="last_communication_at" operator="more_than" value="..." expandable />
      <FilterRow field="stage" operator="excludes_any" value={["Active C..."]} expandable />
      <FilterRow field="phone_is_good" operator="is_true" expandable />
      <FilterRow field="tags" operator="excludes_any" value={["Unsubscri..."]} expandable />
      <FilterRow field="agent" operator="includes_any" value={["Matt Ryan"]} expandable />
      <FilterRow field="tags" operator="includes_any" value={["Expired, wi..."]} expandable />
      <ClearFiltersLink />
    </FiltersPanel>
  )}
</PeoplePage>
```

### Non-obvious Logic

1. **Smart list count vs. shown count:** The badge on the left rail shows 477 (total matching smart list definition), but the table shows "Showing 34 people". The 7 active filters in the Filters panel further narrow results from 477 → 34. The "Update List" button would persist this narrowed filter set as the new smart list definition.

2. **Two-level filtering architecture:** There appear to be two separate filtering mechanisms: (a) the Smart List's own saved filters (which generate the 477 count in the badge) and (b) session/view-level filters shown in the Filters panel (which reduce to 34). "Update List" merges these by saving the current Filters panel state into the Smart List definition.

3. **Columns picker category check state:** The left-panel category checkmarks are derived (computed) — they light up if ANY column in that category is currently enabled. Clicking a category in the left panel does NOT toggle all its columns; it merely switches the right panel to show that category.

4. **Phone icon dual-badge system:** Each phone number in the Last Text Received column can carry 0, 1, or 2 icon badges: the green badge (phone is good/valid) and the purple badge (SMS capable). These are independent boolean flags stored per phone number record.

5. **Contact sub-label below name:** The tag or stage shown in lighter text below the contact name in the table is the contact's "primary" or most recently applied tag (in this case, consistently "Expired Listing"). This is not a dedicated field — it appears to be derived from the contact's tags or stage, and may be the stage field directly.

6. **Last Communication column preview text:** At least one row (row 9, "Warmhol...") shows "7 months ago" as a relative timestamp AND a preview of the message text "Hi, Matt Ryan here—On..." inline in the cell. This suggests the Last Communication cell renders both a relative time AND a message preview snippet when hovered or when the column is wide enough, revealing the communication type was an outbound text/email from Matt.

7. **"Out Of State Home ..." selector:** Likely a secondary filter group or "view" preset that can be toggled independently from the main smart list filters. This allows users to quickly switch between different sub-views of the same smart list (e.g., "All Expireds in Oregon" vs "All Expireds from Out of State").

8. **Column sort and filter icons in headers:** The "▼" funnel icon appears on columns that have column-level quick-filters applied (Tags, Stage, Last Communication), distinct from the "↓" sort indicator. Both can coexist on the same column.

9. **"TCPA Litigators – Hard Stop" list (count: 132):** Special purpose smart list for contacts flagged as TCPA litigators — the "Hard Stop" naming suggests these contacts are excluded from ALL automated communications. This is a compliance-critical list.

10. **Contact row with two names (Charlisse Toney L / Greg Toney L):** FUB supports household/co-contact records where two people share one record (spouse/partner). The Name cell shows both names separated by a slash. The avatar and primary contact logic defaults to one (likely primary contact).
